pages.text: The dimensional mineshaft houses a $(#AA00AA)Djinni$() which opens up a stable connection into an$(br)  uninhabited dimension, perfectly suited for mining. While the portal is too small$(br)   to transfer humans, other spirits can use it to enter the mining $()

pages.title: Operation
pages.text: This 1.12 mineshaft checks space for the whole batch before producing items or spending durability. Empty its output regularly. An extractor routes items into a loaded inventory two blocks below, then falls back to internal output. Redstone stops $()

pages.title: Operation
pages.text: mining and resets progress.$(br)Top automation inserts a miner; bottom and side automation extract output. Replacing the miner starts a fresh countdown.

pages.title: Redstone
pages.text: The dimensional mineshaft has two interactions with redstone:$(br) 1. The spirit will stop working when receives a redstone signal;$(br) 2. A comparator can be used to extract a signal based on occupied slots and lamp durability.$()

pages.title: Redstone
pages.text: $(br)  Tip, if the comparator sends a power of 10, it is better to stop the operations.$(br)

pages.title: Enchantments
pages.text: This 1.12 port uses fixed enchantment effects, unlike the modern upstream random formulas.$(br) $(bold)Efficiency:$() subtract 30 ticks per level, with a minimum of 1 tick;$(br) $(bold)Fortune:$() add one result roll per level;$(br) $(bold)Silk Touch:$() $()

pages.title: Enchantments
pages.text: multiply each roll by 1 plus the enchantment level, together with the miner's base multiplier. Mining dimension core counts are capped to one per roll.

pages.title: Durability
pages.text: Each successful operation spends exactly one durability. This local implementation directly changes damage; it does not apply Unbreaking or external unusing/eternal hooks. It does not consume durability when no output recipe exists or the whole batch $()

pages.title: Durability
pages.text: cannot fit. Use the repair ritual to restore a saved miner.

pages.title: Config
pages.text: This 1.12 port always moves a miner to output when a successful operation leaves one durability. Its name, enchantments and NBT are preserved. There are no local switches for this or the enchantment effects. If the drops and saved miner cannot all $()

pages.title: Config
pages.text: fit, the operation produces nothing and consumes no durability. An already exhausted miner can still break if reinserted.
